853:t_119:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What do you think of replying, 'All set, all muscle, all flesh, OK!'?」

853:t_119:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And strike a pose! Spread your legs for 'all set,' flex your biceps for 'all muscle,' and go dick-a-pop for 'all flesh'!」

853:t_119:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Come now... Join me! All set, all muscle, all flesh, OK!」

853:t_119:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You still have a long way to go, $n. Anyone who cannot cast off their inhibitions will never grasp anything from here on.」

853:t_119:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Yes... a time will come when you must cast everything aside, after all.)

853:t_120:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Congratulating myself really does feel a little empty...」

853:t_120:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I shall not lose heart! I want to praise myself for rising all the way to ace in such a short time!」

853:t_121:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're ignoring me! I did expect it, but...」

853:t_121:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, $$渓$$ and $$凱$$!」

853:t_121:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As I thought, this is the $$ゲッター$$ Team... You and $$凱$$ make up for what $$號$$ lacks, $$渓$$.」

853:t_121:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$號$$ and $$渓$$ combine their strength into a '$$號$$-$$渓$$' total... That is witty.」

853:t_122:4.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「As the leader of $$チームＤ$$, I must accomplish at least this much.」

853:t_122:5.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Well... That is what you call a grown man's dignity.」

853:t_122:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you for your hard work too, $$田中$$.」

853:t_122:7.en:
$$田中司令$$
「I am also a member of the staff supporting $$チームＤ$$, after all.」

853:t_122:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is a good opportunity. Please show us your own version of $$ダンクーガ$$'s traditional 'Let's do it,' $$田中$$!」

853:t_122:10.en:
$$田中司令$$
「I might just go and do it and maybe do a little more or something...」

853:t_122:11.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「I have heard the cry of your soul.」

853:t_123:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I suppose I managed to save face, somehow.」

853:t_123:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You live up to your role as the $$ガンダム$$ pilots' dad! You sound so composed.」

853:t_123:6.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$ハサウェイ$$ is all the troublesome son I need.」

853:t_123:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What would you do if $$ハサウェイ$$ were to pilot a newly designed $$ガンダム$$ in the future?」

853:t_123:8.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I wouldn't do anything. He is no longer a child, after all.」

853:t_123:9.en:
$$ブライト$$
「If that is what he chooses, from that point on I'll simply deal with him as a man rather than as his parent.」

853:t_123:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...Though I say that, deep down I do have mixed feelings about it.」

853:t_123:12.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Let's finish this war quickly, so I won't have any needless worries.」

853:t_123:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand. Let us seize the future with our own hands!」

853:t_124:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「Don't make such a fuss. I merely did my duty.」

853:t_124:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That is admirable, $$オットー$$. Perhaps it is my imagination, but your face seems more resolute than during the $$時獄戦役$$.」

853:t_124:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「I can't tell myself... What do you think, XO?」

853:t_124:7.en:
$$レイアム$$
「With all due respect, I believe $$ＡＧ$$ is right.」

853:t_124:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「Well... It is a compliment, at least. I'll take encouragement from it.」

853:t_124:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You have a fine, mature air, $$オットー$$! Please have this tea as an extra prize!」

853:t_124:10.en:
$$オットー$$
「Hmm... Its astringency gives it a pleasant flavor. This is quite good.」

853:t_124:11.en:
$$レイアム$$
(I hope you mature like that black tea too, Captain.)

853:t_125:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「But I didn't achieve this on my own.」

853:t_125:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes! Congratulations to you too, $$ラッセ$$, $$フェルト$$ and $$ミレイナ$$!」

853:t_125:7.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「It does! We are usually the ones doing all the hard work behind the scenes.」

853:t_125:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have always thought how much I envy you, $$ラッセ$$, surrounded by so many beauties on the bridge.」

853:t_125:10.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If you get as compact as a $$ハロ$$, I might let you stay there.」

853:t_125:12.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「That's how it is. Don't get too many ideas about $$ソレスタルビーイング$$.」

853:t_126:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I am in charge of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$. I must be able to accomplish at least this much.」

853:t_126:6.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Even if it's the $$クォーター$$, it's still a $$マクロス$$.」

853:t_126:7.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「If we don't show fighting prowess worthy of that name...」

853:t_126:8.en:
$$ラム$$
「we will become the laughingstock of the entire fleet.」

853:t_126:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This bridge is a garden of women... This too is a $$マクロス$$ tradition.」

853:t_126:10.en:
$$ボビー$$
「That's right. You understand, don't you, $$ＡＧ$$?」

853:t_126:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes! You too, $$ボビー$$, a maiden at heart, should bloom in all your mysterious glory like a rafflesia!」

853:t_126:12.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Even a man-eating flower is still a flower! I'll do my part in the $$クォーター$$'s flower garden!」

853:t_126:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「With that spirit... you are a fine woman, $$ボビー$$!」

853:t_127:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「With that smile... you are truly an angel... Ahh... If only I could put my hand on those lovely cheeks...」

853:t_127:6.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「You will not lay a hand on our goddess.」

853:t_127:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「M-$$マデューカス$$! Why are you here?!」

853:t_127:8.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I owe my victories to $$マデューカス$$, so naturally I have him attend occasions like this with me.」

853:t_127:9.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Exactly, $$ＡＧ$$. Now, praise the entire crew of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$.」
